title_zh: 决定先阅读条款再完成课程申请

scenario.label_zh: 决定先阅读条款再完成课程申请
scenario.goal_zh: 核对申请仍是草稿及需要补充的材料，并决定先阅读条款再提交

context_zh: 虚构课程平台咨询：申请人与工作人员核对草稿状态，不实际提交任何申请。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: My application status says 'draft'. Does that mean you've received it?

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Not yet. You still need to submit it. I can help you check what's missing.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: The form asks me to specify which evening I can attend. Can I choose both?

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Yes, if both work for you. You also need to attach the short writing sample listed below that question.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: I have the sample ready, but I haven't read the course terms. Is the button below them the final step?

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Yes. Please read those first. You can leave the application as a draft while you decide.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: I'll do that, then add my available evenings and the sample. I won't submit it until I've read everything.
